shorts.title: What you will learn: while loops
shorts.hook: One small mistake can make a loop run forever.
shorts.script: One small mistake can make a loop run forever. Today your program learns to repeat. A loop does the same job again and again, with no copy and paste. A while loop repeats a block as long as its test is true. The test runs before every round. When the test is false, the loop ends. You must change the loop variable inside the body. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: What you will learn: while loops.

shorts.title: while loops in one minute
shorts.hook: A while loop repeats a block as long as its
shorts.script: A while loop repeats a block as long as its test is true. The test runs before every round. When the test is false, the loop ends. You must change the loop variable inside the body. If you do not, the test stays true, and the loop never ends. Think of a ceiling fan. It keeps turning while the switch is on. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: while loops in one minute.

shorts.title: Inside the second program
shorts.hook: The counter i starts at one.
shorts.script: The counter i starts at one. The sum starts at zero. The loop runs while i is at most five. Each round adds i to the sum. After two rounds the sum is three. Then i goes up by one. At the end, the sum is fifteen. The program prints Sum colon fifteen. A while loop repeats while its test is true. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Inside the second program.

shorts.title: Bug of the Day: An off-by-one error
shorts.hook: Can you spot the bug in while loops?
shorts.script: Can you spot the bug in while loops? Bug of the Day. We want the sum of one to five. The program prints ten. The test says less than five, so the loop stops before it adds five. This is an off-by-one error. Check the first round and the last round by hand. Use less than or equal. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Bug of the Day: An off-by-one error.

shorts.title: Pun and challenge
shorts.hook: Can you print a table of two in while loops?
shorts.script: Can you print a table of two in while loops? Why did the loop go to the doctor? It had a problem with its condition, and it kept coming back. Use a while loop to print the table of two, from two times one to two times ten. Write your answer in the comments. A while loop repeats while its test is true. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Pun and challenge.
